name: Third Wheel
source:
Chris, the antelope, wants to date one of his two friends, but his inner self, or "id," has a nasty habit of sabotaging his efforts. This short story is about gay romance and (hopefully) shows what it's like to have intrusive thoughts.

[From [url=https://stinkdog.itch.io/third-wheel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
羚羊克里斯想和他的两个朋友之一约会，但他内心的自我，或者说“本我”，有一个坏习惯，会破坏他的努力。这个短篇故事是关于同性恋浪漫的，并（希望）展示了有侵入性想法的感觉。

[来自[url=https://stinkdog.itch.io/third-wheel]Itch.io[/url]]
